_comment_player_cards: Optional player_cards: ordered list of metric tile ids for /tournament/get_player_section. Valid ids: summary_final_position, summary_average, summary_best_position, best_highest_game, best_highest_pair (Nord/Süd BM lane events), handicap_profile (hcp data in CSV), best_highest_block. Unknown ids are ignored. Omit player_cards to use server defaults (heuristic pair + handicap from event name / data).
_comment_ko_bracket_format: Omit ko_bracket_format (or use single_elim_tree) for classic QF→SF→Final. Use seeded_elim_stepladder for Clubmeisterschaft-style finals. ko_decision_basis=handicap → all elim/stepladder/final comparisons use Score+Handicap (inkl. HDC). Elim outcome=lowest_each_game: each elim game drops the lowest remaining player (not a 2-game combined total). CSV rounds: Eliminierung / Stepladder / KO-Finale.
